# Tall-e

> Prompt Engineering & Conversation Design — portfolio and contact.

Tall-e (tall-e.nl) is the professional portfolio of Tally Brostowsky, a prompt engineer and conversation designer based in the Netherlands.

## What it covers

- Selected work and case studies in prompt engineering and AI conversation design
- The Personified AI project — giving AI personas a distinct voice and character
- About and background
- Contact via an AI-powered contact bot

## Key pages

- / — homepage with portfolio, selected work, and contact
